limitations.note: The rewrite removed the original reset and startup behavior of `ready_a`, allowing the first post-reset edge to accept a bit that the reference would not accept.

The agent registered `valid_b` but also gated it with input acceptance, whereas the reference registers `cnt == 5` alone and therefore keeps `valid_b` asserted on stalled cycles once the count reaches five.
The testbench assumed immediate readiness and a completion-only pulse, so its reset and gap cases validated the rewrite rather than checking the expected startup and count-five stall behavior.
